rationale: The workflow already implements the supported dependency-cache pattern (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) in every job (node_modules cached with a key derived from package-lock.json) and cancel-in-progress concurrency (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE via concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true). Bazel parallelism/incremental-cache patterns do not apply because the project builds with npm, not Bazel. Schedule-based patterns (P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE, P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE) do not apply because there is no schedule trigger. Matrix fail-fast does not apply because there is no matrix. A custom timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) is not supported: the repository reports no measured baseline or duration history, so a safe limit cannot be derived, and valid slow builds (SonarQube analysis, artifact upload, promotion) could exceed an arbitrary limit. Change-path filtering is contraindicated because shared configuration and fixtures affect multiple checks. No new evidence-supported, safe workflow change remains.
